scope: CI installation, native preparation/close and controlled SDK contracts for the exact authorized candidate; no live account feature acceptance

reviewMethod.networkUsedByAuditor: Read-only gh downloads and artifact metadata only
reviewMethod.archiveDifferences: Only platform registration bridge inclusion; all six multi-version cases share one Linux x64-built main archive. Target native resources are fetched by the tested mirror path.

limits: No live account login, restoration, message exchange, member query, group-avatar operation or remote effect is proven by these no-account receipts.
The compiled member APIs and CLI were statically inspected in the archive. Their presence is not a live native member-query result.
Linux ARM64 avatar admission and SSO string-carrier rejection are included in this commit; their bundled evidence is static and explicitly has no native/account/remote-effect validation.
Multi-version receipts explicitly record loginAttempted=false but omit accountUsed, restoreAttempted and nativeSendAttempted; missing fields are not interpreted as false.
Default mirror receipts omit accountUsed; noAccount=true appears in separate video receipts.
Video receipts lack their own sourceCommit/main-archive binding; association comes from the downloaded GitHub artifact, not a self-contained source claim.
Native cache payload bytes are not attached to these artifacts. Cache hashing is recorded by CI and was not rerun locally by this auditor.
GitHub API artifact metadata binds artifact IDs to head/run; this audit does not independently verify artifact attestations or the original downloaded ZIP digest.
SDK quality logs and native npm build artifacts are outside this twelve-main-archive audit; npm publication is not established.
No historical source was recompiled locally; workflow source receipts and GitHub metadata supply the source binding.

nativePackageAudit.method: official GitHub metadata; bounded unauthenticated blob ranges after authenticated API redirect; ZIP CRC and local hash validation; no native or SDK execution
limits: Full ZIP bytes/digests were not fetched or verified; official API digest values remain declarations.
Six native tarball hashes, SHA512 integrity and native manifest hashes are build/release declarations only. Native tarball and manifest bodies were not downloaded.
Prepare/close and installed file hashing are CI consumer receipt evidence, not replayed locally. No SDK or .node file was executed during this audit.
Installed contract fixtures validate public routing/error/lifecycle behavior; their success is not a real-account native feature result.
All six consumers explicitly record loginAttempted=false, accountUsed=false, nativeSendAttempted=false; restoreAttempted is absent and not inferred.
No QR login, real-message arrival, group-avatar side effect, remote signature authenticity, or account longevity proof is supplied.
Native package consumers do not record cold/warm cache metrics; those belong to the separately audited default-mirror run.
The aggregate receipt is byte-identical to Linux x64 consumer; it is not counted as a seventh independent execution.
Only the aggregate main tarball was fetched; six platform pre-aggregation main tarballs, silk-wasm and remote video materials were not downloaded.
Windows stopping probe passed with qqLoaded=false and normalCloseVerified=false; adapter build runtimeVerified=false remains unchanged.
New member information, refresh, missing-member CLI, snapshot and string-SSO-carrier rejection flags are installed controlled-contract receipts, not live account/native-query evidence.

Windows installed CLI entrypoint checks passed, but posixNpmBinEntrypointChecked=false does not prove a Windows npm .cmd shim invocation. PE headers and ZIP CRC/size are static adapter-byte checks only.
publish job skipped establishes no npm publish by this run; no assertion is made about current npm registry state.
Same-commit archive comparison used downloaded 7c CI archives only, never current local product sources; this is not a signed supply-chain attestation.
